teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：定语从句就像给名词戴上一顶“神奇的修饰帽子”。主句里的那个名词叫“先行词”，如果先行词是人，我们就用 who 把它修饰成“正在唱歌的人”；如果是物，就用 which/that 给它贴上“昨天买的物品”等标签！
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
公式：先行词 + 关系词（who/which/that/whose/where/when）+ 从句。
口诀：人用 who，物用 which，that 东西人兼顾；主宾空缺用代词，状语空缺用副词（where/when/why）；whose 表示“……的”，后接名词紧相连！
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
① 代词重复：从句中已经有了关系代词，不能再加 it/him/them（如错写为 The boy who I met him）。
② 地点先行词误用 where：先行词是地点时，若从句缺宾语或主语，仍须用 which/that，只有缺地点状语时才用 where。
③ 介词+关系代词：介词后修饰人只能用 whom，修饰物只能用 which，绝不可用 that。
4. 【经典例句】：
① The girl who is wearing a red hat is my best friend. (戴红帽子的那个女孩是我最好的朋友。)
② This is the interesting storybook which/that I borrowed yesterday. (这是我昨天借的有趣的故事书。)
③ I will never forget the city where we first met. (我永远不会忘记我们第一次相遇的那座城市。)

questions.question: The man _____ is standing under the big tree is my English teacher.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The man'（人），且在定语从句中作主语，故用关系代词 who。

questions.question: I love the cute cat _____ has blue eyes and short fur.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the cute cat'（动物/物），在从句中作主语，用关系代词 which 或 that。

questions.question: Do you know the boy _____ bike was stolen yesterday afternoon?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the boy'，从句中的 bike 与男孩是所属关系（男孩的自行车），故用表示所有格的关系代词 whose。

questions.question: This is the primary school _____ my mother works as a teacher.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the primary school'（地点），从句 'my mother works' 结构完整，缺少地点状语，故用关系副词 where。

questions.question: The red apples _____ are on the kitchen table taste very sweet.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The red apples'（物），在从句中作主语，应用关系代词 that 或 which。

questions.question: The woman _____ lived next door moved to London last week.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The woman'（人），从句缺少主语，故使用关系代词 who。

questions.question: Is this the toy car _____ you bought for your little brother?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the toy car'（物），在从句中作动词 bought 的宾语，故用 that 或 which。

questions.question: Sunday is the day _____ my family usually goes to the park together.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the day'（时间），从句中缺少时间状语（在这一天），故用关系副词 when。

questions.question: A doctor is a helpful person _____ treats patients in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'a helpful person'（人），在从句中作主语，填 who。

questions.question: Look at the little puppy _____ tail is shaking happily!
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the little puppy'，修饰后面的名词 tail（小狗的尾巴），表示所属关系，用 whose。

questions.question: Here is the library book _____ you were searching for this morning.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the library book'（物），在从句介词 for 后作宾语，用关系代词 that 或 which。

questions.question: The beautiful city _____ we visited last summer was full of flowers.
questions.explanation: 注意陷阱：先行词虽然是地点 'city'，但 visit 是及物动词，从句中缺少宾语，因此用关系代词 that/which，而不是 where。

questions.question: My sister lost the silver watch _____ was given by Dad as a gift.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the silver watch'（物），在从句中作主语，用 which。

questions.question: The playground _____ we play basketball after school is very spacious.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The playground'（地点），从句 'we play basketball' 缺地点状语（在操场上），故用 where。

questions.question: Anyone _____ wants to join the school choir should register before Friday.
questions.explanation: 先行词是代词 'Anyone'（指人），在定语从句中作主语，用 who。

questions.question: The defendant provided three alibis, none of _____ were accepted by the judge.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句中的“代词/数词 + of + 关系代词”结构。先行词是 alibis（物），介词 of 后只能用 which。

questions.question: This is the very reason _____ he gave for missing the crucial meeting.
questions.explanation: 易错题！虽然先行词是 reason，但从句动词 gave 缺少宾语，且先行词前有 the very 修饰，必须使用关系代词 that，不可选 why 或 for which。

questions.question: The company is launching a new initiative, the ultimate objective of _____ is to promote renewable energy.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句中的介词后置结构 'the + noun + of + which'，修饰物 initiative。

questions.question: Plastic pollution, _____ has been severely underestimated, now poses a grave threat to marine life.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句（有逗号隔开）。that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面的物应用 which。

questions.question: _____ is often the case with young learners, curiosity drives their rapid progress.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词 as 引导的非限制性定语从句，置于句首，意为“正如……那样”。as is often the case 属于固定结构。

questions.question: Is this the historical site _____ you mentioned in your essay yesterday?
questions.explanation: 先行词虽然是地点 site，但 mention 是及物动词，从句中缺少宾语，故选关系代词 that/which，不能选关系副词 where。

questions.question: The luxurious hotel _____ we spent our summer vacation overlooks the Mediterranean Sea.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 hotel，从句 spent our summer vacation 需要加上介词 in（in the hotel）或用 where。介词后不能用 that，故选 in which。

questions.question: Jack is one of the outstanding students who _____ awarded scholarships by the university.
questions.explanation: 考查定语从句中的主谓一致。在 'one of + 复数名词 + who' 结构中，定语从句的先行词是复数名词（students），谓语动词用复数 have been。

questions.question: Jack is the only one of the students who _____ awarded a scholarship by the university.
questions.explanation: 对比上一题！在 'the only one of + 复数名词 + who' 结构中，先行词强调的是 'the only one'（单数），故定语从句谓语用单数 was。

questions.question: All _____ is needed to complete the project is your final approval.
questions.explanation: 当先行词是不定代词 All 时，关系代词只能用 that，不能用 which。

questions.question: The renowned scientist _____ groundbreaking research transformed the field received the Nobel Prize.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 scientist，从句名词 research 前需表达“该科学家的”，用表示所有格的关系代词 whose。

questions.question: They walked into a secluded room, on the wall of _____ hung a priceless 17th-century painting.
questions.explanation: 考查“介词短语 + of + which”引导的非限制性定语从句及倒装。先行词是 room，介词 of 后用 which。

questions.question: The country has over a thousand islands, the largest of _____ is a popular tourist resort.
questions.explanation: 两句之间用逗号连接且无并列连词（and/but），故属于非限制性定语从句，介词 of 后修饰 islands 用 which。

questions.question: The speaker addressed the audience in a subtle whisper, _____ made it challenging to catch every detail.
questions.explanation: 考查 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，which 代表前面一整句话的内容（说话者低声细语这件事）。

questions.question: I will cherish the unforgettable days _____ we spent together in the mountain village.
questions.explanation: 高频考点压轴！先行词虽为表示时间的 days，但从句动词 spent 为及物动词（spend time），缺宾语，故只能选关系代词 that/which，不可选关系副词 when 或 during which。
